texts.zh:
随着工程师们在气态巨行星的轨道上组装受精卵和卵壳，我们的食品工业也制造好了形成巨卵卵清所必需的营养物质。然而，创造这样一颗受精卵果然更具挑战性。

我们消耗了大量生物飞船和太空兽群的生物质，最后才稳定出一个可用的DNA基础，将其密封在一个前无古人的受精细胞中，显微镜观测也证明了该步骤的成功。现在我们准备指数级扩大实验的规模，唯一要做的就是让这个巨大的卵子受精了。

很快，我们将孵化出这个星系有史以来最巨大的生命形式！
texts.en:
While our engineers worked to assemble the zygote and its shell in orbit of a gas giant, our food industry processed the nutrients necessary to form the albumen of a Behemoth egg. However, creating a viable fertilized yolk has proven to be significantly more challenging.

We exhausted immense quantities of biomass from biological ships and space fauna before finally stabilizing a viable DNA foundation, which we sealed within a groundbreaking fertilization cell. Microscopic trials have proven successful. Now we are ready to scale things up - exponentially. All that remains is to fertilize our gargantuan egg.

Soon, we will hatch the most titanic lifeform this galaxy has ever seen!

label.zh: 我们触碰到了演化的巅峰。
label.en: We approach the pinnacle of evolution.
